description: Reverse ASIN on Amazon US: the observed head search terms where a product appeared on page 1 (organic rank, or a sponsored unit in the page), dated, organic first. Pass asins (up to 10, yours first) to compare with competitors: each keyword shows every competitor's rank, asins_on_page, and gap=true where a competitor is on page 1 and the first product is not; gaps_only=true keeps only those. Coverage is head search terms and page 1 only (the coverage block gives the counts), so a product shows fewer keywords than a full search index would. Not volume figures. Amazon US only.

asin.description: One ASIN. Use asins to compare.

asins.description: Up to 10 ASINs, the product first, then its competitors.

gaps_only.description: With asins: only keywords where a competitor is on page 1 and the first product is not.

name: asin_keywords
